Name: (CP) Everybody is Elliott
Author: Mady0
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=5][b]Make the game your personal hell (or heaven for Elliott lovers!)[/b][/size][/color]

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18681]Everybody is Pam[/url] this mod turn everybody into Elliott. I did have to view [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/191664267]thefatpotato115's[/url]﻿ config files to help bug test, but it is still custom, especially after the 1.6 update.

This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to work.

This is a very simple mod. There are currently some issues. For example, when Willy goes fishing it looks ridiculous. None of the winter outfits have been custom made, but I just made it so that those with everyday custom sprites would use those sprites in winter instead of the previous broken sprites. The outfit may not match, but at least they don't look utterly ridiculous. This doesn't fix all of them, but it does kinda fix some of them.[s]
[/s]
I am sorry, but [b]I've lost all motivation to continue updating this.[/b] I felt so overwhelmed due to the addition of winter outfits and this was supposed to be a silly mod, not stressful. That stress is not good for my disorders, so I am [b]giving up[/b] on updating this mod. I [i]may[/i] in the future, but it is unlikely. If someone wants to make the custom sprites and/or take over I'd be willing to work with you, but [b]I [/b]do not currently have plans on updating it. I was a total amateur at modding AND making sprites, so this offer is up to those with no experience as well. If you have the will and desire to do it, even slowly, please reach out to me.

[color=#ff0000][size=5][b]NEW custom sprites for bachelorettes and a few others.[/b][/size][/color]

There are now custom sprites for every bachelorette, but I haven't made any for winter. This allows them to maintain some of their individuality while still being Elliott. Abigail, for example, still has her bow. This also fixes the sprite issues from just using Elliott's sprites. If you spot any issues with the new sprites please let me know! While I did my best to make sure they are good and even consulted two of my friends (thanks Taco and Bryson!) for assistance on what looks good and doesn't it may not be perfect. With the 1.2.0 update George, Alex, Birdie, and Sandy have custom sprites too. I also made some for Emily's clothing therapy as before they were just themselves.

[center][youtube]2iam-vDGdsI[/youtube]﻿[/center]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][b]Want to make your own for another character, but don't know where to start?
[/b][/size][/color]
You are free to use my files to do that! I made an optional template file so it should be very easy to do, so if you are not making custom sprites you should use it. All I ask for in return is a small mention and if you're feeling generous a link to my mod in the description.

[size=4]But how do I do this?
[/size] ﻿Template guide:
[list=1]
[*]Rename the mod folder to "[CP] Your Mod Name"
[*]Pull the character's sprites from the game folder (Stardew Valley\Content\Characters), both the everyday, beach, and winter then place these in the mod folder.
[*]Rename the files to Everyday.xnb, Beach.xnb, and Winter.xnb and overwrite my assets.
[*]Do the same for the portraits (Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits) with the names Everyday_Portraits.xnb, Beach_Portraits.xnb, Winter_Portraits.xnb
[*]If you are going to release it, open manifest.json (you can do this in a text editor) and update it. I included notes to make this easier. If you are making it for personal use this isn't as necessary.

[/list]Disclaimer! Using the above method your mod will (likely) have the same issues mine had and has for the characters I haven't made custom sprites for, but it is honestly more funny than problematic in my personal opinion.
If you wish to exclude a character rather than replace everyone you will want to use the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide.md]Content Patcher guide[/url]﻿.
